title: Zrike Mickey & Minnie Soup Cereal Bowl - Ceramic, Used
descriptionText: This Zrike bowl features an all-over mickey and minnie soup cereal pattern, perfect for any collector or fan of the iconic duo. Made of high-quality ceramic, this bowl is both durable and stylish, with a width of 5 1/2 inches and a height of 2 3/4 inches. The black color adds a touch of sophistication to any kitchen or dining room. This bowl is ideal for serving soup or cereal, and would make a great addition to any collection.
